Package se.idkollen.client

Class IdkollenClient

java.lang.Object
se.idkollen.client.IdkollenClient
public class IdkollenClient extends Object
Authenticated HTTP client for the IDkollen REST API.

Obtain an instance via IdkollenClientBuilder. All network calls return CompletableFuture and are non-blocking.
